name: Teen Squad (The City Library)
org: Salt Lake City Public Library (The City Library)
what_you_do: Work with a librarian for six weeks to set goals and build a project. You earn volunteer hours and learn job skills.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Now button on the library teens page.
notes: The apply page (services.slcpl.org/teensquad) did not load in our reader, so the dates of each six week session are not confirmed. Ask the library when the next session starts.
